title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Materials)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: </strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency, harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where T2 and T3 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent, and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Success in this role means achieving material cost at or near should-costing, below market indices, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Commodity Insights:</strong> Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends. Deliver actionable intelligence to procurement and leadership on a regular cadence. <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Build and operationalize a live tracking system for key raw material prices, currency movements, and supply risks to proactively surface threats and opportunities.</li> </ul> </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Upstream Cost Engineering:</strong> Construct and scale material-specific clean sheets to lock in baseline component costs before finished-goods production. Provide the costing foundation for Tier 1 negotiations. <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Build material-specific clean sheets for all top raw material inputs to create pricing transparency and support Tier 1 negotiation. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Support Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin target. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Partner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) </li> </ul> </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Tier 2 (and Tier 3) Vendor Strategy:</strong> Map and design an upstream network strategy to consolidate raw material volumes across key material types and maximize direct-to-mill leverage. Reduce supply chain complexity while improving cost and availability.  <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Complete mapping of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 vendor landscape and deliver a defined material and vendor strategy that reduces complexity, ensures capacity, and increases direct-to-mill buying power. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. </li> </ul> </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Material RFPs: </strong>Design and execute RFPs tailored specifically to raw material vendors, yarn spinners/mills, tanneries, and textile mills. Own the full bidding process from vendor outreach through award.  <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Consistently deliver product exceptional material cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Negotiate and execute immediate cost-reduction agreements directly with Tier 2 material suppliers, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term material maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Partner directly with the Material Sourcing, Product Sourcing and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. </li> </ul> </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Value Creation: </strong>Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.  <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">E.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>REQUIREMENTS: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>12-15 years of experience in raw material sourcing, commodity procurement, or upstream supply chain management </li> <li>Deep knowledge of textile raw materials including yarns, fibers, fabrics, leather, and related commodities </li> <li>Experience negotiating directly with mills, tanneries, yarn spinners, and raw material vendors </li> <li>Familiarity with commodity hedging frameworks and global market indices </li> <li>Proven ability to build and execute material-specific clean sheets </li> <li>Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; comfort with large data sets </li> <li>Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks.Experience in upstream supply chain network design or consolidation preferred </li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, sourcing, and production teams </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. </p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. Be part of a compensated on-call rotation Set the technical direction Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. What you need to succeed in this role Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today. Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack. Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation. A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change. A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation. Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems. Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone. Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it. A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone. Experience in using AI for engineering. Nice to haves Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production. Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations. Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it. Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security. Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry. Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching. title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description: Who we are and what you’ll do HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products. Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment. Main objectives of the role As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO. Your role and responsibilities Strategic Software Vision & Architecture : Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces. Execution & High-Stakes Delivery : Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams : Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers. Cross-Functional Alignment : Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways. Business-First Leadership : Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value. Operational Leadership & Partnering : Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction. AI Strategy & Development Workflows : Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use. What you need to succeed in this role Engineering Leadership : Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments Deep-Tech Literacy : Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services. Track Record of Ownership : Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management : Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders. Pragmatic Decision-Making : Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction. AI-Driven Development Strategy : Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows. Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user. We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate. Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too. That's exactly what we're building every single day. tl;dr We're looking for a Chief of Staff who works closely with Nik to structurally build out our company- & org processes. Main information Start: immediately (flexible start) Location: Cologne Workload: Full-time Team: Founder's Office Is this a match? The most important basics – so we both know if it could work. Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week. Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role. Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently. Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community. Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap. What you'll do - your playing field This is how you move our mission forward every day. You own selected strategic and operational projects end-to-end. You take projects from the initial idea and concept through planning and execution to measurable results. You build and continuously improve our core company processes. You create clear structures and scalable ways of working that help the organization operate more effectively as we grow. You work closely with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and priorities. You bring different teams and perspectives together, create clarity on what matters most, and make sure important initiatives move forward. In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also: Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team What you bring to the team We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points. Process & Structure: You think in processes and structures, quickly bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations, and know how to turn them into pragmatic ways of working. Project Ownership: You have experience independently driving projects from idea to execution in a fast-growing environment and are comfortable taking responsibility for both strategy and implementation. Tools: You are confident working with Notion, project management tools, Google Workspace, and Slack and use them effectively to create transparency, structure, and efficient collaboration Good to know We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one. This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you. Bonus Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points. Experience in a high-growth startup Early experience building People/org processes The Prematch Setup We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success. Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive. AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work. 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation. Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote. Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too! Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location. Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger. Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit. Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match. If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special. Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us. title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry. Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff. Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control. German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English. German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users. You take ownership and proactively push work forward. You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams. Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped. You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure. Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus. Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus. Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus. Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus. Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus. An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus. Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks. Potential to participate in the employee stock option program. Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program. A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Recruiter
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it. What You'll Do Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer. Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles. Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search. Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal. Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process. Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down. Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers. What You Need 3+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company. You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles. You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer. You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers. Nice to Haves Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space. A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem. Proven experience on Ashby ATS. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k , plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it. Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly. Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework. Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. Equal Opportunity Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? title: Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System Expert (m/w/d)
description: The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. Join our Team in Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future! title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payment Squad
description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payment Squad. They manage BlaBlaCar’s payment solutions that provide reliability, trust, and a smooth end-to-end experience. As a Senior Backend Engineer, your role will be to drive the delivery of a reliable and scalable platform that supports the full payment lifecycle, fraud fight, and compliance requirements. You will take ownership of complex, cross-functional projects—such as finalizing the implementation of our payment orchestrator—and play a key role in expanding BlaBlaCar's business by proposing and integrating tailored payment methods for our various operational countries. You will act as a technical reference, demonstrating strong autonomy, deep architectural thinking, and the ability to synchronize with multiple external teams (Legal, Cash Management & Finance, Payment Ops). You will be reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager and working closely with a team of Software Engineers and a Product Manager. Your responsibilities Drive and deliver transverse and complex technical projects from design to deployment, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical constraints and implementation challenges. Lead the finalization and scaling of the payment orchestrator and integrate new, adapted payment methods across different countries. Take a step back to proactively propose platform improvements, task automation, and better observability (e.g., establishing SLO reviews with SREs and owning your monitoring and alerting stack). Interact closely with various teams (Legal, Finance, Fraud/Payment Ops) to synchronize efforts, gather requirements, and assess cross-team impacts. Act as a mentor and guide for mid-level (IC3) developers within the squad, elevating the team's overall engineering standards. Participate in a cyclic on-call duty (approximately 1 week every 7 weeks) to ensure the high availability of our critical payment systems. Your qualifications You have 5 to 10 years of overall engineering experience. You possess deep technical autonomy and a high level of critical thinking regarding software architecture and constraints. You are fluent in Java and have advanced knowledge of frameworks such as Spring, or SpringBoot. You have hands-on experience with service-oriented architectures, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog). You have excellent, clear, and concise communication skills, allowing you to easily step into any workshop and share technical expertise with both technical and business stakeholders. title: AI & Automation Engineer / Sales Focus
description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 You'll join Malt's AI & Automation Team to build the AI & Automation backbone of our commercial organization. Working hand in hand with commercial leadership and reps, you'll design the workflows that keep our CRM sharp, surface the right signal at the right time, and power a highly personalized outreach machine. You'll also be the team's eyes on what's next in AI & automation, testing new ideas with beta users and pushing the ones that work into production. Key responsibilities ✨ Design and build AI & Automation workflows (n8n, Dust, and more) integrating Salesforce, enrichment providers, and other data sources to keep CRM data accurate and complete. Manage and maintain integrations across the commercial tool ecosystem (e.g., Aircall, Modjo, Clay) to ensure seamless data flow and eliminate manual syncs. Detect buying signals (company changes, job moves, funding, market shifts) and route them into commercial workflows so reps act at the right moment. Build and scale a highly personalized outreach engine, using LLMs to tailor messaging for the commercial team at scale. Identify beta testers among the commercial team, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on feedback and data. Track AI & automation trends through ongoing tech watch, and bring back new ideas, tools, and patterns. Implement reliability patterns and document the architecture of the workflows you ship. Partner closely with commercial leadership and reps to prioritize the roadmap and train users on new tools. About you 🧑‍🚀 Engineering background: You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering (Bac+5 or equivalent), combining technical rigor with a strong business sensitivity to bridge tech and commercial teams. Automations & Integrations: You have hands-on experience building workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier) and connecting commercial stack tools (Salesforce, Aircall, Modjo, Clay) via native integrations, APIs, or webhooks. AI & Data stack: You are comfortable with the LLM/AI ecosystem (OpenAI API, Dust, LangChain, Mistral) and solid with SQL and scripting (Python/JavaScript) to connect systems end-to-end. Commercial empathy: You understand sales processes and genuinely enjoy working close to commercial teams to remove their daily friction. Languages: You have professional working proficiency in English. How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with Alexandre, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes) A 60-minute session with your future manager, Léo Martin, to explore your background and the role’s specifics. Live practical case with Léo Martin and another Malter in order to evaluate and discuss technical topics, problem-solving approaches, and ways of working. Final interview with Anaïs to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and how you fit into our strategic growth. Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow - Team building events organized every year Ready? Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive. Your profile may be subject to background screening. title: Senior Finance & FP&A Manager
description: Mission Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there. As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build. Your Tasks Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic. Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds. Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early. IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials. GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix. Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions. Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable. Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team. Your Profile Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure. Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions. Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions. Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus. Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English. Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment. Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount. Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome. What we're not looking for People who wait to be told what to do. "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams. Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client. Process We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study Reference call Our Offer Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure Competitive compensation package 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31 Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket Company pension scheme (bAV) Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m. A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model. We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development (apeiron)
description: Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform! Bei Ginmon arbeiten wir in einem Team aus jungen, visionären Experten daran, die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlichem Portfoliomanagement und modernster Kapitalmarkttechnologie zu schließen. Mit unserer Plattform helfen wir Privatanleger:innen, ihre finanziellen Ziele durch ETF-basierte Anlagestrategien effizient und kostengünstig zu erreichen. Nach unserem Erfolg im B2C-Bereich markiert das Jahr 2026 einen Meilenstein: den offiziellen Start von apeiron Wealth ( www.apeiron-wealth.com ). Dabei handelt es sich um unser zukunftsweisendes, KI-natives Betriebssystem für Vermögensberater:innen, das eine hochmoderne, vollautomatisierte Infrastruktur bietet. Diese ermöglicht es Vermögensberater:innen, ihr gesamtes Beratungsgeschäft zu digitalisieren und die Qualität sowie die Tiefe der Kundenbetreuung erheblich zu steigern. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Business Development Team unterstützt du uns bei der Vermarktung des Produkts apeiron und der Generierung neuer Leads. Dabei sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in den Aufbau eines wachsenden B2B-Geschäfts. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können. Du initiierst den Erstkontakt zu unabhängigen Finanzberater:innen über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn) und vermittelst dabei einen professionellen und positiven Eindruck von apeiron. Du vereinbarst Termine mit unserem Business-Development-Manager und unserem CEO und hilfst mit, unsere Strategie zur Produktvermarktung mitzugestalten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst CRM-Datensätze sorgfältig, um eine datengestützte Sales-Pipeline zu gewährleisten. Du setzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude und Gemini sowie Prozessautomatisierung ein, um deine Arbeitsprozesse und die Effizienz im Business Development zu steigern. Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Dabei erwarten dich Perspektiven zur eigenständigen Übernahme von Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereichen, die dir helfen, dich zum Business Development Manager weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit Schwerpunkt Kapitalmarkt, eingeschrieben und hast idealerweise noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir. Du bist kontaktfreudig, kommunikationsstark und trittst auch am Telefon sicher und professionell auf. Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung mit. Du begeisterst dich für innovative technologische Lösungen und KI und möchtest Arbeitsprozesse durch intelligente Tools maximal effizient gestalten. Du bist ein echter Teamplayer, kannst aber ebenso eigenständig agieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Leads und denkst proaktiv mit. Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (wichtig für die Kundenansprache) und verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Du wohnst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und arbeitest flexibel 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, den Markterfolg von apeiron Wealth aktiv mitzugestalten und die digitale Transformation der deutschen Vermögensberatung direkt zu beeinflussen. Maßgebliche Möglichkeiten zum Weiterlernen durch Workshops mit erfahrenen Professionals sowie gezielten Kompetenzaufbau. Direktes Reporting an den Business Development Manager und den CEO sowie flache Hierarchien mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen, perfekt, um wertvolle Business- und Vertriebserfahrung direkt vom Management zu sammeln. Ein internationales, junges und gleichgesinntes Team von Profis mit einer ausgeprägten "Get-things-done"-Mentalität und einer hervorragenden Arbeitsatmosphäre. Eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Klausurenphase und Job dank flexibler Einteilung deiner 16 bis 20 Stunden. title: Account Executive (m/f/d)

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer. This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold. title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. What you will work on Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature. You should bring: Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA , and GPU scheduling The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility Very good English; German is a plus We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience. Nice to have Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF , photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others! You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity. Develop yourself! We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally. And there is even more! In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team. Your Responsibilities As a Training Specialist (m/f/d), you will empower our sales teams and partners to successfully sell, confidently demonstrate, and effectively implement DocuWare solutions for our customers. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop modern learning programs, deliver engaging training experiences, and play a key role in strengthening the success of our sales and partner organizations. Your responsibilities will include: You plan, coordinate, and deliver training programs for our sales teams and partners, ensuring an engaging and effective learning experience. You design modern training concepts and define appropriate methodologies and instructional approaches to enable sustainable knowledge transfer. You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives. You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs. You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations. You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners. You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics. You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs. What you need to succeed You hold a degree in Education, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or have gained equivalent qualifications through relevant professional experience. You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way. You have ideally gained experience in training, enablement, learning & development, or technical support. You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions. You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN. You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions. Experience with DocuWare or other document management solutions is an advantage. You are fluent in both German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. You work independently, thrive in international team environments, and bring strong communication, networking, and interpersonal skills. What we can offer There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them. As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages: Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations. Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours. Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures). Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area. Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time. Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge. Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch. Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free). Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world. Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs. Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan! We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company. Unique benefits : Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs. We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare . title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams. The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan's effectiveness against Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives. This is a hybrid role, based in Paris. Key Responsibilities 1. Integrated Marketing Planning & Business Performance — France Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market. Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar. Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan. Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies. Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans. Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative. 2. Orchestrating 360° Campaigns Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines. Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market. Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams. Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision. 3. Tracking, Performance & Governance Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins. Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs. Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected. Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners. Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans. 4. Agencies & Partnerships Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning. Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners. Ways of Working Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence. Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities. Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders. Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation. Key Skills Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives. Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations. Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution. Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders. Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management. Candidate Profile Experience 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency. Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations. Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies. Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market. Success Measures One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams. Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity. Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans. Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated. Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives. title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design. Key responsibilities In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase: Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design. Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads. Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints. Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases. Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability. Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis. Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification. Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions. Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design. During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase: Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise.
