title: Communications Manager:in | Content & Campaigns mit Schwerpunkt antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit bei GermanDream (m/w/d · Teilzeit)
description: Die Position BERLIN · a b sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream. Über uns GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen. Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate. Deine Rolle Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate. Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen. Du entwickelst Formate und Kampagnen in enger Abstimmung mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektteam und den eingebundenen Fachrollen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick. So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann. Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet Content, Redaktion und Storytelling Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit. Du bereitest komplexe fachliche Inhalte verständlich, niedrigschwellig und zielgruppengerecht auf. Du gestaltest Texte, Posts, Kurzvideos und weitere digitale Formate rund um die Themen und Aktivitäten des Projekts. Du erzählst Geschichten aus Workshops, Qualifizierungen, Kooperationen und Veranstaltungen und machst die Menschen und Perspektiven hinter dem Projekt sichtbar. Du achtest darauf, dass jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll, differenziert und diskriminierungssensibel dargestellt werden. Du passt Inhalte an die jeweiligen Kanäle, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken an. Kampagnen, Social Media und Medienproduktion Du entwickelst und realisierst Kommunikationsformate, Contenstrecken und Kampagnen im Rahmen des Projektes. Du betreust die projektbezogenen Inhalte auf den Social-Media-Kanälen von GermanDream und sorgst für eine verlässliche Veröffentlichung. Du planst und begleitest Veranstaltungen, Videodrehs, Interviews und Videoporträts, breitest Fragen und Abläufe vor und stimmst dich dazu mit allen Beteiligten ab. Du begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen vor Ort, filmst selbst mit und sammelst geeignetes Foto-, Video- und O-Ton-Material. Du schneidest kurze Videoformate selbst und koordinierst weitere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten. Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf. Du unterstützt das Community Management auf unseren Kanälen, wertest Rückmeldungen aus und hältst vereinbarte Moderations- und Eskalationswege ein. Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze. Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab. Du holst rechtzeitig Informationen, Materialien und Freigaben ein und sorgst für klare Absprachen und nächste Schritte. title: Hardware Systems Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: <span class="il">Bengaluru</span></strong></p> <h4><strong>About the department</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. . As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Hardware Engineering, Product teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to troubleshoot and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of storage and compute servers.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p><strong>Exp: 3-5yrs</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with software teams to validate bug fixes and assess performance of new firmware revisions</li> <li>Validate and deploy firmware updates to the fleet, monitoring the progress of the rollout for compliance and reliability</li> <li>Work with server and component vendors to obtain, debug, and maintain the latest updates</li> <li>Work with our Site Reliability Engineering teams to triage hardware problem reports</li> <li>Support our Data Centre Engineering teams in resolving hardware issues</li> <li>Develop and maintain automation tools to update firmware on servers and components in Cloudflare’s fleet</li> <li>Communicate your results and updates through blog posts, internal talks, and tickets</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science</li> <li>Desire to learn about the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/gen-12-servers/">Cloudflare hardware</a> used by <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/application-security/">20% of all web sites</a></li> <li>Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale</li> <li>Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware</li> <li>Knowledge of bash and python and basic Linux task automation</li> <li>Knowledge of x86 server hardware including motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage and firmware updates. Knowledge of other platforms such as arm is a bonus.</li> <li>Knowledge of configuration management principals, in particular we use salt to manage our fleet</li> <li>Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols</li> <li>Knowledge of running production mission critical systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with server hardware architecture</li> <li>Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality</li> <li>Experience of managing large fleets comprising of thousands of servers</li> <li>Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and the ability to observe trends over time</li> <li>Experience with software development tools and processes such as git, Bitbucket and TeamCity and Jira</li> </ul> <p>Fraud Alert: Do not fall victim to recruitment fraud. Cloudflare never charges application fees or requires candidates to purchase third-party certifications or training as a condition of employment. title: Risk Assurance Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland  |💰 <strong>€68,00 - €83,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</strong> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Risk and Compliance team</strong></p> <p>Monzo Bank Europe (MBEU) is the Irish-based subsidiary of the Monzo Group and the strategic launchpad for our expansion across the European Union. We are looking for a seasoned Risk Assurance Manager to provide independent Second-Line of Defence (2LOD) assurance over the design and effectiveness of the bank’s risk management framework, controls and processes. You will ensure that key risks are managed in line with regulatory expectations, internal policies and our risk appetite, providing robust oversight and challenge across the full spectrum of the bank’s risk universe.</p> <p>In this role, you will ensure the bank complies with:</p> <ul> <li>Irish Regulatory Obligations, including CBI, CPC, AML/CFT legislation, and the Companies Act.</li> <li>EU Regulatory Requirements, including DORA, EBA Guidelines, ECB/SSM expectations, and GDPR.</li> <li>Internal Governance, including adherence to risk frameworks, policies, and risk appetite.</li> </ul> <p>Reporting directly to the Director of Risk Assurance, MBEU, you will design, execute, and report on 2LOD assurance reviews covering conduct, financial crime, fraud, credit, and financial risks. Your remit will also include operational risk, ICT and information security, outsourcing, data protection and governance structures. This role is critical in fostering a sound risk culture and supporting senior management and the Board in their oversight responsibilities.You will be instrumental in providing stakeholders with the assurance needed to ensure our growth is safe, resilient and compliant.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Assurance Plan</strong>: Planning, coordinating and executing comprehensive risk assurance activities, including effectiveness reviews to ensure EU-wide adherence to the enterprise risk framework.</li> <li><strong>Thematic Reviews:</strong> Conducting targeted thematic reviews across specific risk areas (e.g., conduct, compliance, financial crime, IT, prudential and strategic risk) to provide in-depth assurance over design adequacy and operating effectiveness.</li> <li><strong>Remediation</strong>: Identifying areas for improvement within the risk management framework and control environment, recommending practical, impactful solutions and tracking remediation efforts to completion.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Engagement</strong>: Proactively engage with business and risk stakeholders to understand Monzo Europe’s products and risk profiles, fostering a collaborative and transparent risk culture.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning</strong>: Contributing to the annual risk assurance plan by providing insights gathered through continuous monitoring of regulatory trends and horizon scanning, market practices and upstream developments.</li> <li><strong>Framework Governance</strong>: Contribute to the continuous improvement of the 2LOD Risk Assurance Framework, Methodology and Terms of Reference to ensure they remain fit-for-purpose and market-leading.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Partnering closely with First-Line of Defence (1LOD) control testing, Group 2LOD, and Internal Audit to ensure alignment while maintaining strict independent challenge.</li> <li><strong>Reporting & Governance</strong>: Contributing to risk governance by reporting thematic insights, trends and remediation progress to senior management committees.</li> <li><strong>Risk Culture</strong>: Promote a strong risk and compliance culture, awareness and training programs across the organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a strong background in risk assurance, internal audit and/or risk management within banking or fintech in the European regulatory and financial services landscape. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to plan and execute diverse assurance activities, from effectiveness reviews to thematic deep dives, with a clear focus on root cause analysis.</li> <li>You’ve led reviews across a wide range of risk areas, including ICT and Information Security, Financial/Prudential (Liquidity, Treasury, Capital), Fraud and Financial Crime (AML/Sanctions), Operational and Conduct Risk (Consumer Protection/Vulnerability).</li> <li>You possess a deep understanding of risk and control frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO) and can practically apply this knowledge to 2LOD oversight.</li> <li>You are skilled in the hands-on identification and testing of risks and controls, with a keen eye for detail and potential weaknesses.</li> <li>You have a track record of identifying gaps within risk management processes and frameworks and recommending practical, high-impact solutions.</li> <li>You combine sharp analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders, offering constructive challenge and influencing at all levels.</li> <li>You have strong data analysis skills, you know how to extract, interrogate and present data in a way that makes complex issues easy for stakeholders to understand.</li> <li>You’re proficient in Google Suite and can build high-quality decks for Committee and Board reporting. Experience with SQL or Python is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €68,000 - €83,000 and Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week </p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of our hiring team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with a member of our Executive team</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors. Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions. Actively contributing to internal discussions. Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables. As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication. We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems. As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors. Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus. Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus. Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers. A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact. Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents. Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus. Willingness to travel outside Europe. We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. What we offer An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team. Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform. Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home. Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe. One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.). Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement. Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work. A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies. Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required. A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years. How to apply We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. We look forward to receiving your application by 30th of September 2026 via our website. For reasons of objectivity, we ask that you refrain from submitting an application photo. We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability and age, and sexual orientation. Our offices are not completely barrier-free, but we are open to find individual solutions. title: Technical Support Engineer, Application Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical </strong><strong>Support Engineer</strong><strong> for Application Services/Performance </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's App Services solutions with confidence. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor for our Enterprise customers, responding to and resolving inquiries and incidents related to Application Services/Performance, while delivering timely, high-quality and personalized assistance.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving DNS, HTTP Errors, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network, and other Application Services/Performance related configurations.</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Operations teams to remediate issues, suggest steps to mitigate, and apply the appropriate mitigation, when applicable.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (dig/traceroute/curl/tcpdump).</li> <li>You have experience writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript, or other scripting language.</li> <li>You have experience installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, and IIS.</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>You must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience working as a Technical Support Engineer supporting globally distributed reverse-proxy CDN platforms, with hands-on expertise in content caching, performance optimization, traffic routing, and edge delivery services similar to Cloudflare’s core network offerings.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of L4/L7 protocols and concepts including, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/S, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network with a particular focus on Anycast concepts.</li> <li>Have experience using online diagnostic and monitoring platforms — including DNS lookup tools, global ping and traceroute testers, SSL/TLS configuration analyzers, and synthetic transaction or real-user monitoring services — to troubleshoot DNS resolution, network latency, certificate issues, and global service availability problems.</li> <li>Have experience using investigative observability tools such as Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, Sentry, and live log-tailing utilities to analyze logs, trace issues, and pinpoint root causes of performance or reliability problems.</li> <li>Confident with command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git.</li> <li>Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS.</li> <li>You are competent at writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting language.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a shift-based or global support environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with SLA/KPI metrics and real-time queue management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty. Our humble expectations You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring: Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision. Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization. Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. title: Senior Territory Account Executive (Digital Native), ANZ (Based in Brisbane/Sydney/Melbourne)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Sydney / Brisbane / Melbourne</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>Within this organisation, the Australia Digital Native and Startup team partners with cloud-first, software, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, AI and other high-growth companies. These customers move quickly, build globally and expect technology partners who can match their pace while helping them strengthen security, performance, reliability and developer velocity.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of Digital Native and Startup customers across Australia. You will engage founders, executives, engineering leaders and security teams, helping fast-growing businesses build and scale on Cloudflare’s connectivity cloud. Partner with Customer Engineers, Customer Experience and Professional Services on deployment plans tied to clear milestones and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust pipeline using internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources including BDR, Channel, Marketing and ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions to digital native, startup, scale-up or high-growth technology companies.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota in a fast-paced new-business or growth sales environment.</li> <li>Proficient in prospecting, discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing and multi-threaded land-and-expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, computer networking, application security and modern developer platforms, with the ability to learn complex technology quickly.</li> <li>Experience engaging technical buyers and business executives, including founders, CTOs, CIOs, CISOs and engineering leaders.</li> <li>Established relationships across Australia’s digital native, startup, venture capital or technology ecosystem are highly regarded.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication, executive presence and value-selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments and core systems such as Salesforce, Tableau and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment with new ways of working.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonab

title: Named Sales Director, East
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, Raleigh, NC or Charlotte, NC</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Sales to manage a team of Named Account Executives in the Washington DC, Raleigh or Charlotte area. This leadership role within the Enterprise team focuses on both the acquisition of new accounts and the expansion of existing customer accounts. The ideal candidate will possess a strong sales management background and a technical foundation, enabling them to drive engagement with both technical professionals and executive buyers. As a Sales Director, you will have the opportunity to position and differentiate the Enterprise platform experience for Cloudflare while reinforcing strong pipeline and automated forecast management practices across Security, Network, Development, and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Accurately forecast commits by month and quarter, leveraging automated internal data layers and predictive metrics to consistently deliver attainment to quarterly and annual sales targets.</li> <li>Oversee, coach, and motivate a team of 8 Account Executives, measuring success against overall quota attainment, new logo acquisition, and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Develop and uplevel team selling abilities through consistent focus on enablement, solution selling, and interpreting automated, data-led customer insights.</li> <li>Assist in the continued codification and execution of product-focused playbooks to connect platform data to Cloudflare solutions that solve critical business challenges.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, and Product Marketing to optimize sales training and accelerate execution around newly launched features and products.</li> <li>Maintain a robust funnel of new hire candidates by continuously interviewing and building a strong network of potential talent.</li> <li>Hold regular 1x1s with team members, maintaining open and transparent communication while monitoring the proficiency and adoption of sales enablement tooling and resources.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of Sales Management experience leading high-performing sales teams at a high-growth SaaS company.</li> <li>Proven record of high performance in consistently meeting and exceeding team plan through strategic acquisition and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Experience developing relationships with highly technical customers and selling through modern, data-driven Product-Led Growth (PLG) models.</li> <li>Coaching-level knowledge of Gap Selling, Sandler, Challenger, or other structured sales methodologies.</li> <li>Strong talent for multi-threading across business units to identify, engage, and close new divisional buyers, as well as driving consensus among internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent written communication, presentation, and pipeline management skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading sales teams specifically within Cloud Security or Hyperscaler ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex accounts undergoing Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) to expand the partner ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <ul> <li>Compensation will be adjusted based on location and level.</li> <li>For Washington DC Area based hires: Estimated On Target Earnings of $415,000 - 571,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</strong></p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Commercial(e) Terrain Rennes
description: <h2>Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?</h2> <p>Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.</p> <p>Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s’agit d’un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu’à la signature.</p> <h2>Votre rémunération</h2> <p>Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :</p> <ul> <li><strong>30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe</strong></li> <li><strong>27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible</strong>, à 100 % des objectifs</li> <li>Soit un <strong>package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels</strong></li> <li>Un <strong>variable entièrement déplafonné</strong> : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser <strong>100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale</strong></li> </ul> <p>Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li>Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité</li> <li>Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées</li> <li>Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits</li> <li>Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain</li> <li>Gérer l’intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu’à la signature</li> <li>Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée</li> <li>Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs</li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous vous proposons</h2> <ul> <li>Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente</li> <li>Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales</li> <li>Une grande autonomie dans l’organisation et le développement de votre secteur</li> <li>Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance</li> <li>Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech</li> <li>Des perspectives d’évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d’encadrement</li> </ul> <h2>Ce poste est fait pour vous si</h2> <ul> <li>Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la <strong>prospection à froid</strong>, idéalement sur le terrain</li> <li>Vous êtes à l’aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt</li> <li>Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain</li> <li>Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance</li> <li>Vous faites preuve d’aisance orale, d’énergie et de force de conviction</li> <li>Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant</li> <li>Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats</li> <li>Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération</li> <li>Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes</li> </ul> <p>Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.</p> <h2>Vos avantages</h2> <p>En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :</p> <ul> <li><strong>25 jours de congés payés</strong>, auxquels s’ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)</li> <li><strong>Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d’ancienneté</strong></li> <li><strong>Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé</strong></li> <li>Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : <strong>allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d’une carte de frais professionnels</strong>, <strong>remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics</strong> ou <strong>budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an</strong></li> <li><strong>Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €</strong></li> <li><strong>Indemnité Internet de 36 €</strong></li> <li><strong>Mutuelle d’entreprise</strong></li> <li>Accès à <strong>Wellpass</strong>, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être</li> <li>Accès à notre plateforme CE d’avantages salariés</li> <li>Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec <strong>Livi</strong></li> <li>Accès aux services de <strong>La Maison Bleue</strong></li> <li>Accompagnement proposé par <strong>Action Logement</strong></li> <li>Programme de recommandation interne</li> <li>Des opportunités régulières de formation, d’apprentissage et de développement professionnel</li> </ul> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <ol> <li><strong>Échange avec un recruteur</strong> – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations</li> <li><strong>Entretien avec le manager</strong> – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle</li> <li><strong>Mise en situation commerciale</strong> – Exercice pratique permettant d’évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain</li> </ol> <h2>À propos de SumUp</h2> <p>Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d’accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu’ils font de mieux.</p> <p>Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd’hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — <strong>Founder’s Mentality, Team First et We Care</strong> — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.</p> <p>SumUp est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.</p> <h2>Un dernier conseil</h2> <p>Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.</p> <p>Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.</p> <p><strong>Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Writer
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence. In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander) Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update Interface & System Specifications Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines Operational & Field Documentation Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates Client-Facing Delivery Documentation Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications Candidate Profile - Experience 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators) Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. About the Role We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies. Responsibilities: Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement Candidate Profile: Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work) Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus) Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing) Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed Nice to Have Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation) Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware Prior startup or skunkworks experience Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
